title: Lina Bo Bardi's birth chart
metaDescription: Lina Bo Bardi's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 12.5° Sagittarius. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: The Moon stands at 12.7° Cancer, in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. Of everything the chart can be read for without a birth time, that is the loudest single fact in it.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's exact place is 12.5° Sagittarius. That falls in the second decan, 10°–20°, sub-ruled by Mars in the classical scheme — a fire sign read through a mutable season.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: Mercury holds 26.0° Scorpio, Venus holds 0.3° Sagittarius, Mars holds 17.5° Sagittarius — in the old shorthand, a mind that absorbs before it argues; taste that runs toward the vivid and the immediate; drive that ignites on contact.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Start where the chart is tightest — Venus trine Neptune, 0.1° of separation. The scheme reads trines as water finding its level: effortless, and invisible to the person living it. Behind it, Mars sextile Jupiter at 0.1°, and Saturn conjunction Pluto at 1.4° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. These are the day-proof angles — present at midnight, present at noon, present at the next midnight.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: The Moon stands apart from every major angle the day held — the tradition reads an unaspected planet as a voice that speaks on its own schedule, unmodulated by the rest of the chart.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Two planets here sit in a sign the classical scheme scores. The Moon in Cancer at 12.7° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Saturn in Cancer at 0.1° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain. Condition, not character: that is all the dignity table ever measured.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Among the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, the elements divide 4 fire, 4 water, 2 air; by modality, 4 fixed, 3 mutable, 3 cardinal. No settled placement falls in earth — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. Venus, Saturn, Neptune and Pluto were retrograde — motion that reverses only from this vantage point, and which the old reading treats as delay used for revision.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Cancer for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 12.4° between midnight and midnight. The missing clock moves the Moon by half a sign at most here, and the boundary was never close. At the noon reference it stands at 12.7°.
